title: The events-driven ops platform for AI-powered businesses
excerpt: LiveWire connects the tools you already use and routes every event to an AI agent, another tool or a dashboard. Rules, monitors and effects included. Closed alpha.
content_html:
Now in closed alpha

A no-code platform that helps you turn your event data into tasks for your AI workforce.

LiveWire

Rules and monitors

AI agentsAct on events

Support agent, fix agent, list agent. Idle until a rule hands them work.

Other toolsWebhooks

Team chat, on-call, Zapier or your own endpoint.

DashboardsLive feeds

Payment succeededAtlas · Pro plan

+$49

Pull request merged#412 · Fix retry logic

Effects and alertsBig moments

Confetti for the wins, a red alert for the failures.

Works with

Plus any tool that can send a webhook.

How it works

Events in. Decisions made. Work done.

Everything your tools do becomes an event. You decide what each kind of event should trigger, once.

1

Connect your tools

Add Stripe, Shopify, Render, GitHub, Supabase and more in about two minutes each. Anything else comes in through a webhook or an RSS or Atom feed.

2

Decide what happens

Write rules on any property: amount, source, sentiment, status. Add monitors that catch silence and spikes. No code.

Amount over $200Deploy failedNo signups for 6 hours

3

Let the right thing act

Hand the event to an AI agent, route it to another tool by webhook, light up a dashboard, or play an effect for the big moments.

Monitoring

Watch everything on one live board.

Not every event needs an agent. Pin the ones you want to see on a live dashboard, one column per product, store, client or rep.

Pick a use case

Features

Everything between an event and an outcome.

Rules, agents, alerts and views, built around the events your tools already produce.

Event rules

If this happens, do that

Match events on source, amount, sentiment or any property, then send them to a webhook or hand them to an AI agent with instructions you wrote once. Limits and an event log keep it safe.
